core_question: How do I dry leather shoes that got soaked in the rain without ruining them? (secondary: How do I fix clothes that picked up dye/color bleeding from another item in the wash?)
answer_summary: Remove excess water, stuff the shoes with crumpled newspaper (changing it as it dampens) to absorb moisture and hold shape, and let them air-dry at room temperature away from direct heat or sun.; after the topic shift: Rewash the affected garments immediately, before they dry, using a dye/color-run remover product in hot water to strip out the transferred dye; repeat if needed.
